literal_meaning: নির্বাচিতের নির্বাচিত (the chosen of the chosen)
figurative_meaning_en: The very best, supreme or top-quality
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বাজার থেকে বাছের বাছ কিনে নিয়েছি।
example_sentences_in_english: I bought the cream of the crop from this market.
All his sons are the best of the best.
note: Often used in contexts of selecting superior items, like crops or livestock, reflecting rural Bengali life.
